items.question: Do I need an account to convert text to handwriting?
items.answer: No. You can paste text, preview a page, and complete a useful Free export without signing in. An account is needed to keep your monthly quota across days or subscribe to Pro. Saved export history is not currently provided. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】

items.question: How does the text to handwriting converter work?
items.answer: You paste or type text, choose a handwriting style and paper, preview the page, and download PDF or PNG. You can also set margins, line spacing, ink colour, and optional natural variation for appearance.

items.question: What can I use Writey for?
items.answer: Writey is for personal notes, revision, letters, journals, accessibility needs, and teacher or classroom examples. It is not positioned for submitting generated pages as handwritten school work when that would break your institution’s rules. Read Acceptable Use before you export.

items.question: Is Writey an AI handwriting generator?
items.answer: No. Writey is a typographic tool that lays out typed or pasted text in handwriting-style fonts. We do not describe the MVP as “powered by AI”. Some people search for “AI handwriting generator” when they want a text-to-handwriting converter; that phrase is not our product name.

items.question: Can I convert Hindi text as well as English?
items.answer: Yes. The editor supports English and Hindi (Devanagari) for preview and PDF or PNG export. See the Hindi support page for a focused walkthrough.

items.question: Is the website available in Hindi?
items.answer: No. The MVP interface is English. Hindi is supported for input, preview, and export, not as a full Hindi interface.

items.question: Does Writey support other Indian languages?
items.answer: No. Languages beyond English and Hindi are not in the MVP. They may be considered later and are not sold as a current add-on.

items.question: What file formats can I download?
items.answer: You can download PDF or PNG. Both Free and Pro include these formats. Export quality and watermark rules depend on your plan.

items.question: Do Free exports have a watermark?
items.answer: Yes. Free exports include a visible brand watermark that does not cover your text. This is an ordinary brand watermark, not a scan-disguise effect. Pro exports have no watermark.

items.question: Do you keep the text I paste?
items.answer: We do not keep your source text as a long-term archive. If an export is processed on a server, the text is handled only as needed to complete the task and is not written into analytics logs. Exact retention of short-lived files is described in the Privacy Policy.

items.question: How long can I re-download a file?
items.answer: Saved export history is not currently provided. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】 In the current product, PDF and PNG files download in your browser and are not kept in an account history you can reopen later. Download again from the editor if you still have the text open.

items.question: What are the Free plan limits?
items.answer: Free is $0 and allows up to 8 export pages per calendar month, with a watermark, standard quality, and 8 handwriting styles. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】 Daily preview and per-job caps also apply. The core path works without an account.

items.question: What are the Pro plan limits?
items.answer: Pro is a recommended $3.99 per month or $39 per year, in USD, and allows up to 150 export pages per calendar month, with no watermark, higher export quality, and all licensed MVP styles. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】 These amounts are not a live offer until confirmed. Daily preview and per-job caps still apply.

items.question: What happens when I reach my page cap?
items.answer: You can still open the editor and edit your text, but a new export that would exceed the cap is refused. You can wait for the quota to reset, or upgrade to Pro if you are on Free. We do not sell an add-on pack in this MVP.

items.question: Are previews unlimited if I upgrade?
items.answer: No. Pro raises the daily preview cap; it does not remove the cap. After you reach the daily preview limit, you can keep editing and wait until the next reset.

items.question: Why do I need an account for Pro?
items.answer: An account is required so we can bill the subscription and apply your quota. Guest use remains available on Free for the first useful preview and export. Saved export history is not currently provided. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】

items.question: Is it okay to submit these pages as handwritten school work?
items.answer: No, not if that would break your school or college rules. You are responsible for how you use anything you export. See Acceptable Use for allowed uses and academic integrity rules.

items.question: Do you offer tools to make pages harder to detect?
items.answer: No. We will not build or sell features whose purpose is to evade teachers, OCR, or detection tools. Optional natural variation (tilt, ink pressure, slight drift) is for appearance only.

items.question: Does Writey clone my handwriting?
items.answer: No. The MVP does not clone your own handwriting. It uses licensed handwriting-style fonts. Handwriting cloning is not an MVP feature or paid add-on.

items.question: How much does Pro cost?
items.answer: The recommended display prices are $3.99 per month or $39 per year, in USD. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】 These figures are a proposed structure, not a confirmed live offer. Applicable taxes will be shown at checkout.

items.question: Is Pro unlimited?
items.answer: No. Pro has a monthly cap of 150 export pages, and previews have daily and per-job caps. 【PENDING CONFIRMATION】 Neither plan is unlimited.

items.question: Can I buy a Lifetime plan or a Business plan?
items.answer: No. We do not sell a Lifetime plan in this MVP. Business, Teams, or Education access, if shown, is waitlist or contact only and has no public price.

items.question: How do payments and taxes work?
items.answer: Payments will be processed by a third-party provider, to be confirmed. We do not name a vendor as if it were already contracted, and we do not collect full card numbers or UPI secrets in Writey forms. Applicable taxes will be shown at checkout.

items.question: What is your refund policy?
items.answer: Refund requests are handled under our Refund Policy. The commercial window is still being confirmed. This draft does not take away rights that applicable law says you cannot give up.

items.question: How do I join the Teams or Education waitlist?
items.answer: Use the waitlist or contact form on the Pricing page, or email `support@text2handwriting.site`. This is a request to be contacted, not a purchase.
